A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] served as the '''attendant''' at the [[Shrine of Healing]] on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She welcomed the pilgrims that arrived at the [[Shrine of Healing]]. When the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] and [[Gaden-Ko]] arrived at the Shrine, the attendant sent Gaden-Ko to the healers for medical aid.<ref name="TOR" />
